 Lewas name 14 for emerging nations tournament
 By The National 
 November 10, 2026 
 Share 
 Facebook WhatsApp Email 
 CRICKET PNG has named a 14-member PNG Lewas squad for the International Cricket Council (ICC) Women’s Emerging Nations Trophy 2026, scheduled for today, Nov 10-26 in Ajman, United Arab Emirates.
 The tournament would feature 10 national teams, with PNG drawn in Group A alongside Sri Lanka, Ireland, Scotland and the United Arab Emirates.
 The squad, including head coach Tim McCaskill, assisted by Mahuru Dai, team manager Anthea Murray and physiotherapist India White, departed Port Moresby yesterday for Brisbane, Australia, before heading to Ajman, United Arab Emirates.
 Lewas would use the international competition as an opportunity to build experience, improve competitiveness and continue strengthening their position in international women’s cricket. The tournament also forms part of the team’s broader development towards the ICC Women’s T20 World Cup 2028 qualification pathway, which will require PNG to progress through the official ICC qualifying process.
 PNG’s fixtures will kick off on Thursday against Scotland, before taking on Sri Lanka on Sunday, Nov 15. Right after that, PNG will take on Ireland on Nov 16 before closing their campaign against the hosts, UAE, on Nov 18.
 The group winners will make it to the next league challenge to compete to qualify between Nov 20-25, based on the ICC tournament fixture.
 Apart from PNG, 10 countries that will compete in this tournament are Sri Lanka, Ireland, Scotland, United Arab Emirates (UAE), Pakistan, Bangladesh, Thailand, Netherlands and Zimbabwe.
 PNG LEWAS: Brenda Tau, Pauke Siake, Tanya Ruma, Dika Lohia, Geua Tom, Hane Tau, Henao Thomas, Hollen Doriga, Erani Pokana, Lakshmi Rajaduri, Naoani Vare, Buruka Vicky, Sibona Jimmy, and Kevau Gabe.
